description: 函数A中引用了仅在函数B中定义的变量（跨函数复制粘贴导致变量污染）

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: 同一文件中两个函数，变量在一个函数定义在另一个函数使用
abstract_signature.example_fix: 在func_a中声明变量或从func_b传入

fix_template: 检查变量是否应在当前函数内声明，或从调用方传入

description: dict.get()/.get() 返回值直接链式调用属性/下标，未检查None

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: 函数参数直接访问属性/下标，无if is not None守卫
abstract_signature.example_fix:
if val is not None:
    val.method()

fix_template: 在访问前添加: if $VAR is not None:

description: 函数参数可能为None，直接访问属性或调用方法

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: 函数参数未做is None判断，直接访问.attr或调用.method()

fix_template: assert $PARAM is not None 或 if $PARAM:

description: 函数调用时传入参数数量与定义不一致

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: 同文件中函数定义与调用的必需参数数量不匹配
abstract_signature.example_trigger: track_event()需要2个参数但被传入4个参数

fix_template: 检查函数定义，确保调用参数与签名一致

description: 使用裸except或except块中仅pass，异常被静默吞没

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: except未指定类型或except块中只有pass
abstract_signature.example_trigger: except: pass 导致所有异常被静默忽略

fix_template: 指定具体异常类型，至少记录日志

description: except块中返回空值（None/[]/{}），调用方无法区分正常和异常

abstract_signature.example_trigger: except: return None 掩盖了真实的错误原因
abstract_signature.example_fix: 记录异常日志，重新抛出或返回错误信息对象

fix_template: 记录异常日志，考虑重新抛出

description: import语句引用了不存在的模块或符号

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: import的模块在sys.path或项目目录中不存在
abstract_signature.example_trigger: from executor_service import 不存在的函数
abstract_signature.example_fix: 确认模块中存在该函数，检查__init__.py导出

fix_template: 检查目标模块的函数/类是否确实存在且已导出

description: 函数默认参数使用可变对象（[]/{}/set()），多次调用共享同一对象

abstract_signature.example_fix:
def func(x=None):
    if x is None: x = []

fix_template: 使用None作为默认值，函数内部初始化可变对象

description: 循环中创建的闭包（lambda/def）捕获了循环变量的最终值而非每次迭代的值

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: for循环中定义lambda或嵌套函数引用循环变量
abstract_signature.example_trigger: for i in range(3): funcs.append(lambda: i)

fix_template: 使用默认参数绑定当前值: lambda x=$VAR: ...

description: 使用 == 比较None/True/False而非 is，可能导致意外行为

abstract_signature.example_trigger: if result == None: 而非 if result is None:
abstract_signature.example_fix: 使用 is None / is not None

fix_template: 使用 is 而非 == 比较单例对象

description: f-string中包含JSON花括号，容易冲突或转义遗漏

abstract_signature.example_fix: 使用json.dumps()代替手动拼JSON字符串

fix_template: 使用json.dumps()或模板引擎

description: 文件/连接/锁未在with语句中关闭，可能导致资源泄露
fix_template: 使用with语句确保资源自动释放

description: 异步函数调用未使用await，返回协程对象而非实际结果

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: async def调用了另一个async函数但未用await

fix_template: 在异步函数调用前添加await

description: 使用字符串格式化/f-string拼接SQL查询，存在SQL注入风险

abstract_signature.example_fix: 使用参数化查询: cursor.execute('... WHERE id=?', (uid,))

fix_template: 使用参数化查询代替字符串拼接

description: 硬编码文件系统路径，跨平台/部署时失效

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: 字符串包含绝对路径（C:\ 或 /home/）
abstract_signature.example_fix: 使用pathlib.Path和相对路径或环境变量

fix_template: 使用相对路径或配置/环境变量

description: List/dict/set as function default argument
fix_template: Use None as default: def f(items=None): items = items or []

description: Defined as async but no await inside
fix_template: Use async HTTP client (httpx/aiohttp) or remove async

description: File/socket opened without with statement or close()
abstract_signature: f = open(path); data = f.read() # no close
fix_template: Use with open(path) as f: or ensure f.close() in finally

description: Thread started but never joined or daemonized
fix_template: Add t.join() with timeout or set t.daemon = True

description: except: pass silently swallows all exceptions
fix_template: Use except Exception as e: logger.error(...)

description: Top-level import between mutually dependent modules
abstract_signature: from module_a import X in module_b (and vice versa)
fix_template: Move import inside function or restructure modules

description: Type-dependent comparison that may behave unexpectedly
abstract_signature: if value == None vs if value is None
fix_template: Use is None / is not None for singleton comparison

description: Check-then-use file operation without atomicity
abstract_signature: if os.path.exists(f): open(f) # file may be deleted
fix_template: Use try/except OSError instead of pre-check

description: Regex with nested quantifiers on user input
fix_template: Use atomic groups or re2 library, set timeout

description: Temp file created with predictable name
fix_template: Use tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile() or mkstemp()

description: fork() without exec() in multi-threaded context
fix_template: Use multiprocessing module with spawn start method

description: Direct equality comparison of floating-point numbers
abstract_signature: if a == 0.1: # may fail due to precision
fix_template: Use math.isclose(a, b, rel_tol=1e-9)

description: Decorator without @functools.wraps
abstract_signature: def my_decorator(f): def wrapper(*a): return f(*a); return wrapper
fix_template: Add @functools.wraps(f) to wrapper function

description: Module-level mutable variable modified across functions
fix_template: Use class with instance variables or thread-local storage

description: os.environ[] without default or error handling
fix_template: Use os.environ.get('DATABASE_URL', default_value)

description: Database connection opened without pool/context manager
abstract_signature: conn = psycopg2.connect(...)  # no context manager, no return to pool
fix_template: Use connection pool (SQLAlchemy, asyncpg pool) or context manager

description: Generator expression passed to function expecting sequence
abstract_signature: any(x for x in items)  # fine. But: len(x for x in items)  # always 0?
fix_template: Convert to list comprehension if multiple consumption needed

description: Non-async-safe function in signal handler
fix_template: Only set flag in signal handler, process flag in main loop

description: exec() or compile() on potentially user-influenced string
fix_template: Never exec() user input. Use restricted interpreters or sandboxes

description: String equality in authentication susceptible to timing attack
abstract_signature: if user_token == expected_token:  # early exit leaks timing
fix_template: Use hmac.compare_digest(user_token, expected_token)
